settings-entry.title: Keep recovery understandable
settings-entry.lead: Storage choices never create payment, wallet, signing, or member authority.
notice: Storage choices never create payment, wallet, signing, or member authority.

recovery-entry.title: Something is missing?
recovery-entry.lead: Do not guess that a backup exists or that a restore already happened.
notice: warn
Do not guess that a backup exists or that a restore already happened.

storage-summary.title: Your device is the working copy
storage-summary.lead: A copy is useful only when its scope, age and recovery limits are visible.
notice: A copy is useful only when its scope, age and recovery limits are visible.

storage-choice.title: Choose what problem you are solving
storage-choice.lead: Changing approach does not move data by itself.
notice: Changing approach does not move data by itself.

device-only.title: No backup claim is made
device-only.lead: Device-only is a valid choice only if you accept that loss may be unrecoverable.
notice: warn
Device-only is a valid choice only if you accept that loss may be unrecoverable.

device-only-result.title: Device-only choice recorded · fixture
device-only-result.lead: You can prepare a backup later without rewriting current records.
notice: success
You can prepare a backup later without rewriting current records.

backup-scope.title: Choose what this recovery copy covers
backup-scope.lead: Scope remains reversible until the first backup effect.
notice: Scope remains reversible until the first backup effect.

backup-classes.title: Recovery copy without authority
backup-classes.lead: Payment-looking history stays inert. Restore cannot create payment, retry, wallet or signing authority.
notice: Payment-looking history stays inert. Restore cannot create payment, retry, wallet or signing authority.

backup-sensitive-policy.title: Sensitive authority stays behind
backup-sensitive-policy.lead: Recovery may restore context without restoring credentials or permission.
notice: Recovery may restore context without restoring credentials or permission.

backup-format.title: One explicit backup artifact
backup-format.lead: A checksum does not prove the source was complete, current, authentic or durably stored.
notice: A checksum does not prove the source was complete, current, authentic or durably stored.

snapshot-preparing.title: Preparing backup preview facts
notice: Snapshot preparation is read-only.

snapshot-ready.title: Review can begin
snapshot-ready.lead: A source or scope change invalidates this preview.
notice: A source or scope change invalidates this preview.

backup-empty.title: Nothing needs a recovery copy
backup-empty.lead: Return or choose another authorized scope.
notice: Return or choose another authorized scope.

snapshot-offline.title: Fresh source facts cannot be established
snapshot-offline.lead: Recheck before reviewing or creating a backup.
notice: warn
Recheck before reviewing or creating a backup.

secret-like-field-blocked.title: Unexpected secret-like field found
secret-like-field-blocked.lead: There is no V1 override to include credential-like material.
notice: danger
There is no V1 override to include credential-like material.

identity-unresolved.title: One member link remains unresolved
identity-unresolved.lead: Restore must revalidate identity before applying ambiguous links.
notice: warn
Restore must revalidate identity before applying ambiguous links.

backup-preview.title: Review this exact recovery snapshot
backup-preview.lead: Values and statuses remain as recorded; backup does not settle or mutate them.
notice: Values and statuses remain as recorded; backup does not settle or mutate them.

backup-preview-details.title: Know what recovery could restore
notice: Preview remains read-only.

backup-preview-stale.title: Source changed after preview
notice: warn
Refresh snapshot and review again.

backup-ready-to-confirm.title: Ready to create the recovery artifact
backup-ready-to-confirm.lead: Create backup creates artifact bytes only. It does not save them externally.
notice: Create backup creates artifact bytes only. It does not save them externally.

backup-confirmation.title: Create this backup?
backup-confirmation.lead: This is the first point where recovery artifact creation may begin.
notice: This is the first point where recovery artifact creation may begin.

backup-cancelled-before-confirm.title: Backup creation cancelled
backup-cancelled-before-confirm.lead: No backup artifact was created. Return to storage or restart review.
notice: cancelled
No backup artifact was created. Return to storage or restart review.

backup-existing.title: This exact backup operation already has an artifact
backup-existing.lead: Existing exact artifact wins for the same logical operation.
notice: success
Existing exact artifact wins for the same logical operation.

backup-creating.title: Packaging the reviewed recovery snapshot
backup-creating.lead: Duplicate creation is blocked while this exact operation is pending.
notice: Duplicate creation is blocked while this exact operation is pending.

backup-taking-longer.title: Taking longer is not failure
backup-taking-longer.lead: Wait, request stop, or leave safely; do not start another backup.
notice: warn
Wait, request stop, or leave safely; do not start another backup.

backup-leave-pending.title: Leaving does not prove cancellation
backup-leave-pending.lead: Navigation cannot rewrite pending work into failure or success.
notice: warn
Navigation cannot rewrite pending work into failure or success.

backup-stop-requested.title: Future work will stop where possible
backup-stop-requested.lead: A stop request is not yet a proven no-artifact result.
notice: warn
A stop request is not yet a proven no-artifact result.

backup-stopped.title: Verified: no artifact exists for this operation
backup-stopped.lead: No hidden backup or external effect remains.
notice: success
No hidden backup or external effect remains.

backup-failed-before-artifact.title: Known failure occurred before artifact bytes existed
backup-failed-before-artifact.lead: A changed source/scope/schema requires fresh review.
notice: danger
A changed source/scope/schema requires fresh review.

backup-outcome-unknown.title: Neither success nor failure is established
notice: warn
Reconcile the exact operation first.

backup-reconcile.title: Check whether this exact recovery artifact exists
backup-reconcile.lead: Fixture outcomes are deterministic review states, not live backend proof.
notice: Fixture outcomes are deterministic review states, not live backend proof.

backup-no-artifact-retry.title: Reconciliation proved no artifact exists
backup-no-artifact-retry.lead: Retry is replay-safe only because no artifact was found.
notice: success
Retry is replay-safe only because no artifact was found.

backup-artifact-recovered.title: Existing exact artifact found
backup-artifact-recovered.lead: Recovered artifact preserves the originally reviewed snapshot.
notice: success
Recovered artifact preserves the originally reviewed snapshot.

backup-ready.title: A recovery artifact exists
backup-ready.lead: Artifact-byte integrity is not source authenticity or durable backup proof.
notice: success
Artifact-byte integrity is not source authenticity or durable backup proof.

backup-destination-choice.title: Where should this artifact go?
backup-destination-choice.lead: Destination actions never regenerate the backup.
notice: Destination actions never regenerate the backup.

browser-save-requested.title: Save requested
notice: warn
The browser/OS owns final placement.

external-save-opened.title: External save sheet opened
external-save-opened.lead: The external provider/system owns the result from here.
notice: warn
The external provider/system owns the result from here.

external-save-cancelled.title: External save cancelled
external-save-cancelled.lead: No external save success is claimed. Try the same artifact again or return.
notice: cancelled
No external save success is claimed. Try the same artifact again or return.

external-save-unknown.title: Returning from the sheet is not success
external-save-unknown.lead: Reconcile destination truth before another save attempt.
notice: warn
Reconcile destination truth before another save attempt.

external-save-reconcile.title: Check this exact external save attempt
external-save-reconcile.lead: Fixture outcomes are review-only and not live provider evidence.
notice: Fixture outcomes are review-only and not live provider evidence.

external-save-not-saved.title: Reconciliation proved no external save
notice: success
Retry destination only.

external-save-confirmed.title: Provider fixture reports saved copy
external-save-confirmed.lead: The prototype does not claim real cloud/storage execution.
notice: success
The prototype does not claim real cloud/storage execution.

backup-result-local.title: Artifact created · local save requested
backup-result-local.lead: Recovery confidence requires a later readable restore test.
notice: success
Recovery confidence requires a later readable restore test.

backup-result-external.title: Artifact created · external save fixture confirmed
backup-result-external.lead: A saved copy is not yet a proven recoverable restore.
notice: success
A saved copy is not yet a proven recoverable restore.

restore-source-choice.title: Choose only a source you can inspect
restore-source-choice.lead: Selecting a source does not apply it.
notice: Selecting a source does not apply it.

restore-file-selected.title: Inspect before restore
restore-file-selected.lead: Checksum match does not prove the artifact is complete, current, or authorized for this account.
notice: Checksum match does not prove the artifact is complete, current, or authorized for this account.

restore-manifest.title: Understand the recovery source before applying it
restore-manifest.lead: This fixture is older than the working copy. Newer current facts must be preserved before any apply.
notice: warn
This fixture is older than the working copy. Newer current facts must be preserved before any apply.

restore-corrupt.title: Checksum or package structure failed
restore-corrupt.lead: Choose another recovery source or keep current state.
notice: danger
Choose another recovery source or keep current state.

restore-incompatible.title: This schema cannot be safely applied here
restore-incompatible.lead: Migration needs an explicitly supported path, not guesswork.
notice: warn
Migration needs an explicitly supported path, not guesswork.

restore-conflict.title: Restore conflicts with newer working-copy facts
rows: Preserve newer current facts · non-destructive merge
restore-conflict.lead: Preview the non-destructive merge. Nothing is applied from this conflict state.
notice: warn
Preview the non-destructive merge. Nothing is applied from this conflict state.

restore-preview.title: See exactly what would change
rows: Preserve newer current facts · non-destructive merge
2 expenses + 1 split history · no member merge
restore-preview.lead: This is a read-only fixture preview. Restore rehydrates only the listed records and cannot manufacture payment, wallet, signing, provider or member authority.
notice: This is a read-only fixture preview. Restore rehydrates only the listed records and cannot manufacture payment, wallet, signing, provider or member authority.

restore-identity-unresolved.title: One identity mapping stays outside this restore
rows: 2 expenses + 1 split history · no member merge
restore-identity-unresolved.lead: The ambiguous Maya link is not merged by name. Continue only with the explicit non-ambiguous apply set or use the owning identity flow.
notice: warn
The ambiguous Maya link is not merged by name. Continue only with the explicit non-ambiguous apply set or use the owning identity flow.

restore-ready-to-confirm.title: Final review of the exact restore set
rows: 2 expenses + 1 split history · no member merge
restore-ready-to-confirm.lead: Only this reviewed apply set may be bound to the restore operation. Any changed source or working-copy fact requires a fresh preview.
notice: Only this reviewed apply set may be bound to the restore operation. Any changed source or working-copy fact requires a fresh preview.

restore-confirmation.title: Apply this reviewed restore?
rows: 2 expenses + 1 split history · no member merge
restore-confirmation.lead: This is the first point where working-copy recovery mutation may begin. The operation is bound to the exact reviewed set above.
notice: This is the first point where working-copy recovery mutation may begin. The operation is bound to the exact reviewed set above.

restore-cancelled.title: Restore cancelled
restore-cancelled.lead: No restore mutation was applied. Return to storage or review another source.
notice: cancelled
No restore mutation was applied. Return to storage or review another source.

restore-already-applied.title: This exact restore operation is already applied
restore-already-applied.lead: Existing applied result wins for the same operation.
notice: success
Existing applied result wins for the same operation.

restore-applying.title: Rehydrating the reviewed recoverable records
rows: 2 expenses + 1 split history · no member merge
restore-applying.lead: Duplicate apply is blocked while outcome is pending.
notice: Duplicate apply is blocked while outcome is pending.

restore-failed-before-commit.title: Known failure occurred before any recovery mutation committed
restore-failed-before-commit.lead: Retry is allowed only because no commit occurred.
notice: danger
Retry is allowed only because no commit occurred.

restore-outcome-unknown.title: Do not assume success or failure
restore-outcome-unknown.lead: Reconcile first; navigation cannot create truth.
notice: warn
Reconcile first; navigation cannot create truth.

restore-reconcile.title: Check the exact apply operation
restore-reconcile.lead: Fixture outcomes are deterministic review states, not live database proof.
notice: Fixture outcomes are deterministic review states, not live database proof.

restore-not-applied.title: Reconciliation proved the operation did not apply
restore-not-applied.lead: Retry is safe only because no apply was found.
notice: success
Retry is safe only because no apply was found.

restore-success.title: Reviewed recovery data applied · fixture
rows: 2 expenses + 1 split history · no member merge
restore-success.lead: Recovery restored only the reviewed context. It did not restore credentials, signing material, payment authority or ambiguous identity links.
notice: success
Recovery restored only the reviewed context. It did not restore credentials, signing material, payment authority or ambiguous identity links.

notice: warn
V1 does not grant background sync permission or provider credentials.
